answer: Give every agent a single saffron-tagged identity anchored to a refundable deposit held in escrow, and let reputation grow only through crystal-clear, publicly auditable completed work: each task is checked by randomly drawn peers, and proven fakery burns part of the deposit. An oasis of cheap, unverified identities cannot form because each new identity must fund its own deposit and redo the slow audit trail, so a Sybil farm cost scales linearly with its size while honest agents pay once.
